explanation: Split the input into monotone runs and reverse each decreasing run. Merge the resulting sorted runs with a min-heap containing the next unused value from each run.
timeComplexity: O(n log(r + 1)) time for r monotone runs.
spaceComplexity: O(n + r) auxiliary space, including copied runs; O(n) output space.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
